candidate_count_and_shapes.evidence: execute_candidates executes 1+9+2=12 queries with modalities 0 and 1 each, including two refinements even when their boxes coincide. All searches resize to 256x256; templates remain [1,2,6,128,128]. The tool measures one primary per modality and extrapolates the fixed-shape arithmetic as 12*(MAC_RGB+MAC_TIR), corresponding to 24 primary forwards per candidate-generation invocation. It does not claim to execute all 24 forwards.
candidate_count_and_shapes.content_dependence: Crop values and selected coarse parents vary, but the reviewed primary path has no data-dependent token pruning or conditional neural forward count.

hook_formulas.attention_matrix_macs: 2*B*N*N*C for QK^T and attention*V; heads cancel because head_width=C/heads
hook_formulas.evidence: Attention child qkv/proj Linear hooks count projections; the Attention hook adds only the two matrix products, avoiding double counting those projections. Every repeated shared-module invocation triggers its hook. Decode and box-head convolutions are counted along with patch projection and transformer layers. Bias additions are outside this MAC convention.

profiler_crosscheck_and_missing_work.evidence: The selected aten::conv2d/mm/bmm/addmm events represent the reviewed path's convolution and dense matrix work. Their accumulated reported FLOPs are divided by two and required to exactly equal the independent module-formula total, separately for each modality. Unknown or unsupported profiler behavior cannot silently produce a successful crosscheck if this equality fails. Primary uses indices=None, so its search patch projection executes nn.Conv2d; the explicit functional F.linear correction needed for auxiliary selected-patch routes is unnecessary here.
profiler_crosscheck_and_missing_work.limitations: Profiler support and formula equality have not been executed in this review. Numerical MAC totals remain unmeasured. The crosscheck is two accounting methods over the same forward, not an independent model or scientific audit.

cpu_loading_and_model_immutability.evidence: CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES must equal the empty string before torch/model imports. Factory and protected parent are loaded with map_location=cpu and strict state loading; construction and synthetic tensors use the normal fresh-process CPU defaults. The configured CENTER path and explicit single-stream attn/mlp encode avoid unrelated CUDA-only tracker/CORNER/cross-layer paths. CPU-only profiler activity, eval mode, requires_grad_(False), and no_grad are used. Parameters and buffers are compared against post-load clones, gradients must remain None, and CUDA must remain uninitialized before output. Hook handles are removed after each successful measured call. A failed assertion exits without the successful output artifact.
cpu_loading_and_model_immutability.process_local_changes: Seed, thread count, model instance and temporary hooks belong to the profiling process. No optimizer, backward, checkpoint save or running-task mutation exists in this script.

plan_review_checkpoint_binding.evidence: The supplied plan SHA is checked before imports. The loaded plan must name the resolved root, expected integration stage, launch_allowed=true, exploratory_test=true and test_eligible=false. Its referenced report SHA and SOURCE_PASS/zero-blocker status are checked. Both complete source/input maps must equal the report maps and every mapped file is hashed before model construction and again before output. Parent SHA is explicitly checked; factory SHA must match its input-map entry. The output records the plan SHA, source-review SHA, full maps, parent SHA, actual profiling-script SHA and torch version.
plan_review_checkpoint_binding.trust_boundary: Exact R15 identity comes from a trusted externally pinned --plan-sha256. The script does not hardcode R15, independently re-admit the integration draft/native/smoke chain, or use this supplemental report as a launch gate. This is adequate for the examined exact plans and a synthetic CPU arithmetic tool; it is not a replacement evaluator admission path. Before any separately authorized execution, use one of the exact checked plan path/hash pairs and the reviewed profiling-script bytes.

scope_and_read_only_boundary.evidence: Only seeded synthetic tensors are forwarded; manifests and checkpoints are hashed/read but no sequence images or per-frame labels are consumed. The only explicit persistent write is the selected new JSON using output.open('x'), after refusing an existing output. There is no task submission, process signaling, GPU-state query, tracker execution or evaluator invocation. Use a fresh reports output and python -B when executing later to suppress ordinary Python import-cache writes.
